items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: I think Louis Primo was playing in the pit at that time.

ctx.x: Yeah. Oh, and. Bert Law was in the show. Yeah. Bert Law, he, he lived in, uh, New Jersey City. Well, I can look it up because they've got books about Jimmy Darcy and Tommy Darcy and Red Nickels. Yeah. There's plenty of people that know that. Oh, uh, when the machine was off, you were telling me about your brother going to New York. Yeah. At one time, he was getting booked up there.

Yeah, I was trying to think of the guy's name, uh, this guy was at, uh, a master's ceremony. Mm-hmm. Uh, and he came down and worked at the Strand, uh, not the Strand, but the, the Sanger Theater, the new Sanger at that time was the new Sanger. Uh, from, uh, he was, he was the emceeer of the, of the, of the show, and they had some kind of a, I don't know, some kind of a show, worked out, and my brother's band played with him. Mm-hmm. On the stage, and they had a band in the pit. I think Louis Primo was playing in…
